notes.base_routing_policy_version: base_routing_policy_version is the deployment's routing+pricing hash BEFORE the harness overrides (emptied model_pool, endpoint-file prices, max_escalations 0, and any --variants weights); it identifies the base config, not the exact settings the sweep ran under.
notes.breaker_off: router_online:breaker_off is the control: the same online arm with the step-7 circuit breaker disabled.
notes.case_clock: Both non-cold arms use a synthetic case clock: case k happens at t_k = k x seconds_per_case (1 ms sub-steps within a case) and is scored reading at t_k, so availability decay (half_life_s) and latency staleness depend on seconds_per_case -- quote it with any number. The step-7 breaker (router_online, unless breaker_off) runs on the SAME case clock, so seconds_per_case also sets how much of an open cooldown a case gap actually covers: at seconds_per_case == cooldown_s (30 by default) the FIRST open period ends exactly at the next case (its read lands at t >= open_until, i.e. already half-open), so that first cooldown is invisible in the chosen chains -- only a later, doubled cooldown can span a full case gap. At seconds_per_case >= max_cooldown_s no cooldown, however many times it has doubled, can ever outlast one case gap, so the breaker never excludes anything: router_online and router_online:breaker_off produce identical chains (a documented no-op, not a bug -- see TestBreakerCaseClockInteraction).
notes.case_order: router_online and router_warm_prior depend on the suite's case order: a case is scored with what earlier cases taught the arm, and outages are indexed by case position.
notes.failure_latency: A failed attempt with unknown failure latency (e.g. a live failure) counts as 0 ms in latency figures.
notes.router_cold: router_cold scores every case with an empty signal store: the no-measurement baseline.
notes.router_online: router_online is the reported arm: its store holds only the attempts this arm itself made on earlier cases (failovers included), applied after each case is scored; an error counts only when production's counts_as_endpoint_unhealth would count it. B45 is read from router_online:<variant>.
notes.router_warm_prior: router_warm_prior replays every matrix row of every earlier case (all eligible endpoints) before scoring a case: a full-information reference (not an upper bound), never the reported number.
notes.violations_units: policy.violations_total counts ATTEMPTS (every attempt outside the case's eligible set, plus sweep calls); each strategy's violation_rate is per CASE (at most one per case).
